decks.notes: The deck is focused on utilizing graveyard recursion and self-mill to quickly fill the graveyard with key combo pieces like Stinkweed Imp, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam. Combo pieces like Creeping Chill and Ichorid help to deal damage and bring back creatures from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will, Grief, and Force of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent. Bazaar of Baghdad is used to quickly put cards into the graveyard. The goal of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and powerful combo.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo to take extra turns and generate advantage. The deck also utilizes Coveted Jewel to ramp out mana and draw cards, with additional support from cards like Mishra's Workshop, Tolarian Academy, and Paradoxical Outcome. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with extra turns and card advantage.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage while using Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion for additional value. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan, protecting its own key cards, and generating incremental advantage over time through efficient use of its resources. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually win through incremental card advantage and control of the game state.

This Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while paving the way for victory through card advantage and board control. It utilizes powerful spells like Force of Will and Demonic Tutor to dictate the flow of the game, while also incorporating efficient removal spells like Fatal Push. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in the late game. With a balanced mix of disruption, card draw, and mana acceleration, this deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast its opponents in Vintage 1 vs 1 matchups.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using various artifact cards such as The One Ring, Mana Crypt, and Coveted Jewel. It aims to generate a significant amount of mana through cards like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith, while also utilizing cards like Tinker and Karn, the Great Creator to search for essential pieces like Time Vault and Paradoxical Outcome. The deck includes control elements like Force of Will to protect the combo and disruption cards like Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel and various artifact mana sources to generate massive amounts of mana. Using cards like Grim Monolith and Paradoxical Outcome, the deck aims to quickly ramp into its win conditions, such as Karn, the Great Creator or Phyrexian Metamorph copying Coveted Jewel, to overwhelm opponents with card advantage and game-ending combos. Additionally, the deck includes disruption elements like Force of Will to protect its key pieces and ensure its combo can go off smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using powerful control spells and disruptive creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Mana Drain, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck aims to counter and remove threats while also using cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to draw cards and find key pieces. The deck also includes a companion in Lurrus of the Dream-Den, providing additional value and recursion for low-cost permanents.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card draw to set up a powerful combo with Paradoxical Outcome. By bouncing a large number of artifacts back to hand, the deck can generate a significant amount of mana and card advantage. It includes key cards like Mox Opal, Mana Crypt, and Urza's Saga to help ramp up and generate the necessary resources for the combo. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional value by allowing for recursion of key pieces from the graveyard.

The main theme of this deck is to establish a disruptive and aggressive board presence using artifacts. By utilizing cards like Phyrexian Revoker, Thorn of Amethyst, and Sphere of Resistance, the deck aims to slow down the opponent while deploying threats like Stonecoil Serpent and Patchwork Automaton to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator for additional utility and card advantage. With a focus on mana acceleration and disruptive elements, this Aggro-MUD deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with its artifact-based strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug to power out powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Ichorid. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Force of Will, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The goal is to quickly assemble the powerful Dredge engine to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes a small number of disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Chalice of the Void to protect its game plan.

This UW Control deck focuses on powerful card advantage and disruption to control the game. The deck contains a variety of counter spells, card draw, and removal to keep the opponent on the back foot. The inclusion of Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher helps to shut down opponent's card draw while cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares provide efficient answers to threats. The deck also includes powerful win conditions like Teferi, Time Raveler and Dack Fayden to close out the game once control is established.

The key strategy of this deck is to assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday, which allows the player to stack their deck in a way that guarantees a win condition. The deck includes powerful cards like Vampiric Tutor, Demonic Tutor, Necropotence, and Thassa's Oracle to help enable the combo quickly and efficiently. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and fast mana acceleration, this deck aims to set up a winning sequence of cards and spells in as few turns as possible to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and disruptive creatures to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck aims to control the game's pace and limit the opponent's options. Additionally, with access to cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, the deck can draw into essential resources and pull ahead in card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through precision control and resource management.

The deck focuses on using hatebears to disrupt opponents while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It utilizes cards like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Stillmoon Cavalier and Seasoned Dungeoneer to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration with cards like Ancient Tomb and Moxen to get ahead early and maintain control of the game. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's plans while applying pressure to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. It utilizes powerful cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Wasteland to disrupt opponents while drawing cards with Ancestral Recall and digging through the deck with Brainstorm, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise. The inclusion of a companion, Lurrus of the Dream-Den, allows for additional value by recurring low-cost permanents. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through efficient answers and card advantage.

This Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog. The deck also utilizes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage and find the necessary answers. With a focus on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to outlast its opponent and secure victory through powerful spells and strategic play.
